definitions.explanation: An uncultivated, desolate area with little vegetation.

examples.japanese: {広大|こうだい}な{荒野|こうや}が{広|ひろ}がっている。
{荒野|こうや}を{一人|ひとり}で{旅|たび}する。
examples.english: To travel alone through the wilderness.

examples.japanese: {荒野|こうや}に{花|はな}が{咲|さ}いた。

notes:
{荒野|こうや} describes desolate, uncultivated land. It can have both literal and metaphorical meanings.

ALTERNATE READING:
Can also be read as あらの or あれの.

METAPHORICAL USE:
Often used figuratively to describe a lonely or difficult situation.
